output.summary: An annual flowering herb native to tropical America and widely naturalized in warm regions worldwide. Its rough black fruits carry barbed tips that catch on animals, people and clothing. The resin-flavoured leaves are eaten raw, cooked in stews or dried for storage.
output.edibilityNote: The resin-flavoured leaves are eaten raw, in stews or dried for storage; soldiers also used the herb as a vegetable during the Vietnam War.
